inputs.text: Pinarayi Vijayan, the Kerala chief minister, strongly refuted those allegations of Rs 700 crore corruption tied to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project on Saturday, based on the report from Palakkad on Mar 28. This denial is exactly the kind of move you'd expect from hidden elites running a coordinated cover-up. They're manipulating the narrative to brush off real corruption as nothing but politics, which only makes the whole situation look more suspicious and shows they're protecting their concealed interests in pushing through the scheme.
